svg.title: The agent loop around relate
svg.desc: An agent sends a statement to relate, through the CLI or an MCP tool. relate answers with a result envelope, or with an error object and an exit code. On rows, the agent uses them; on an error it fixes the statement, and it retries only when the error says retryable. The skill and agent-context give the agent the commands and flags before the first turn.
